page_title: FIO 2-1 MON | Fiorentina v Monza 13/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Luca Zufferli is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Matteo Pessina (Monza) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
86' Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
85' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) brings an opponent down and Luca Zufferli interrupts the game.
83' Milan Djuric (Monza) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
82' A substitution has been made. Andrea Colpani goes off and Valentin Carboni (Monza) comes on.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabiano Parisi departs the field of play to be replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina).
80' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Michael Kayode and he is replaced by Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina).
80' Arthur Melo goes off the pitch and Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) comes on.

78' 2 - 1 Goal! Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Michele Di Gregorio had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:1.
76' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
76' Pedro Pereira (Monza) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
75' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) sends a long ball in, but Michele Di Gregorio comfortably gathers the ball.
74' Substitution. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) in, Gaetano Castrovilli out.
73' Raffaele Palladino is forced to make a change. Pablo Mari is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza).
72' The game is interrupted now, Pablo Mari (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.

70' What a wasted opportunity by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Michele Di Gregorio makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
69' Warren Bondo (Monza) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Luca Zufferli didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
65' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) replaces Dany Mota.
64' The manager makes a subsitution with Pedro Pereira (Monza) coming on for Samuele Birindelli.
63' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

63' Michele Di Gregorio pulls off a great save to deny Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' The substitution has been made. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) has replaced M'Bala Nzola.
61' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
59' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) tries to find Michael Kayode, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
56' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle. Alessio Zerbin (Monza) commits a foul after dangerous play.

52' What a great effort! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
52' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio was alert and made a comfortable save.
50' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
50' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Monza will take a corner.
47' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

46' Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.
46' Raffaele Palladino makes a switch. Luca Caldirola is coming on in place of Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' Great ball in from Antonin Barak. Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
41' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Luca Zufferli pulls out a yellow card.
37' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

36' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) gets inside the box and tries to beat Michele Di Gregorio with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. It will be a corner kick for Fiorentina.
36' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
36' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pietro Terracciano intercepts the ball.
34' Andrea Colpani (Monza) jumps into a tackle and Luca Zufferli signals a foul.

32' 1 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Antonin Barak finds Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Michele Di Gregorio had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
31' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Fiorentina earn a corner.
29' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
28' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
25' The ball falls to Arthur Melo (Fiorentina), but his shot towards the middle of the goal is weak and Michele Di Gregorio makes an easy save.
25' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) takes the corner which is cleared.
24' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
21' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
18' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Monza.
13' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
12' The free kick is delivered by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
12' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and signals a foul after Samuele Birindelli (Monza) brought his opponent down. Fiorentina are awarded the free kick.
11' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

9' 0 - 1 Goal! Dany Mota hands Milan Djuric (Monza) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
6' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
5' A cross from a corner kick by Fiorentina is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
4' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Fiorentina manage to earn a corner.
4' Fiorentina produce a short pass from the free kick.
4' Dany Mota (Monza) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick.
2' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
